recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white. 2. Add title 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' in bold dark red (#8B0000) sans-serif at top-left. 3. Place a yellow circle with '23' at the top-right corner. 4. Top-left: draw a 2x2 confusion matrix table with red borders; header 'Predicted as' spanning columns P and N; row header 'Actual' with rows P and N; fill cells with TP=4, FN=1, TN=1, FP=5. 5. Add a red-bordered box labeled 'Threshold=0.4' to the right of the matrix. 6. Upper-right: build a left-to-right flowchart: (a) cream box 'Test Sample' with a small document icon; (b) arrow to dark red box 'Model' containing a tiny plot icon and text '[Any value] → (0, +1)'; (c) arrow to box '(0 — 1)' with label 'Predicted Value' above; (d) arrow to red box 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)'; (e) two arrows branching to green boxes 'Class I' and 'Class II'. 7. Bottom two-thirds: draw a red horizontal axis from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks and labels at 0.0, 0.5, 1.0. 8. Add a blue dashed vertical line at 0.4. 9. Scatter simple airplane outline drawings above the axis; mark left-side airplanes with red dots and right-side airplanes with blue dots to illustrate threshold separation. 10. Ensure all text is verbatim and colors match the described hex values.
